QuantaAlpha Backend API FastAPI-based REST + WebSocket API for factor mining and backtesting. Integrates with the core QuantaAlpha CLI to launch experiments and reads factor library JSON for the factor browsing API.
QuantaAlpha AI - 智能因子挖掘平台
TaskContext — Global Task State Management Lifts mining and backtest task state, WebSocket connection, and polling logic to App level, so running state is not lost when switching pages.
QuantaAlpha API Service Centralized API client for communicating with the FastAPI backend. Uses fetch (no extra dependency) with the Vite proxy (/api -> localhost:8000).
